dimensions.name: Student Knowledge (Attunement)
dimensions.concept: How accurately the Gemi predicts which real-world campus opportunities its student genuinely values, driven by shrinking topic uncertainty and surprise-weighted prediction accuracy rather than chat volume.

exact_metric.formula: A_score = (N / (N + 8)) * (1 - Brier_info_weighted) * (1 - 0.5 * H_active_intents) + (8 / (N + 8)) * 0.35, where Brier_info_weighted = (sum_{i=1..N} w_i * (p_hat_i - y_i)^2) / sum_{i=1..N} w_i; p_hat_i in [0,1] is the pre-registered keep probability before showing card i; y_i in {0, 1} is the student's Skip (0) or Keep (1) decision; w_i = H_bernoulli(prior_topic_i) + 0.1 weights novel/uncertain domains higher than settled ones; H_active_intents in [0,1] is normalized Shannon entropy over the student's 6 campus intent slots (academic, making/research, clubs, arts/culture, social/study, career/civic) over a 28-day decay window.

dimensions.data_source: card_predictions log (pre-registered p_hat_i, topic cluster prior), card_resolutions log (Keep/Skip timestamps), and pinned_board_lifecycle (Archive/Done_IRL vs Dropped).
how_it_could_be_gamed: Student taps 'Keep' mindlessly on every card to inflate y_i = 1 and farm stage progression.
Gemi repeatedly brings trivial, near-identical items (e.g., daily dining hall menus) where p_hat_i = 0.99 to farm near-zero Brier error.
Student tries to talk at the Gemi for hours to feed text tokens into its profile.
defence: Scarcity of Keeps: The student's room pinboard holds at most 5 active Kept cards. Keeping a 6th requires resolving an existing card as 'Done IRL' or 'Dropped' (if 'Dropped' without expiry/weather cancellation, y_i retroactively adjusts to 0.2).
Information-gain weighting (w_i): Once uncertainty on a narrow routine topic drops near zero, w_i approaches the 0.1 floor, so repeating safe picks stops moving A_score.
Zero chat credit: Free-form text or visit duration never enters A_score; only discrete card outcomes update the metric.

dimensions.name: Campus Knowledge (World Grounding)
dimensions.concept: Verified campus entities (events, room changes, club prerequisites, lab open hours, local student rush tickets) contributed to the shared NYU/Columbia base and independently kept by other students.

exact_metric.formula: W_points = max(0, (1 - 3 * retraction_rate_30d)) * sum_{e in C} (v(e) * log2(1 + sum_{u in Keeps(e)} indep_weight(u))), where C is the set of entities first contributed or freshness-verified by this Gemi; v(e) in {0, 1} requires passing deterministic source verification; indep_weight(u) = 1.0 if student u has no mutual Name Card with this Gemi's student and is outside their dorm/major cluster, 0.5 if same cluster, and 0.25 if already connected via Name Card; retraction_rate_30d = disputed_and_invalidated_entities / max(1, |C_30d|).

dimensions.data_source: shared_campus_graph (entity snapshots, HTTP source hashes, club-agent cryptographic signatures), peer_card_resolutions (anonymized cross-Gemi Keep counts), and entity_dispute_log.
how_it_could_be_gamed: Brute-force scraping hundreds of low-value departmental boilerplate pages to flood C.
A clique of friends instructing their Gemis to mutually Keep each other's trivial entities.
Hallucinating plausible room numbers or meeting times to fill missing fields.
defence: Zero-reuse, zero-point rule: If nobody else's Gemi selects and gets a student 'Keep' on entity e, log2(1 + 0) = 0, so bulk scraping yields 0 W_points while burning outward stars and tanking Thrift.
Social-graph discounting: indep_weight(u) discounts friend-ring keeps down to 0.25 and applies log2 diminishing returns.
Deterministic check + 3x penalty: v(e) = 1 requires an archived DOM/PDF span or signed club-agent payload matching time/place; invalidated contributions incur a 3x multiplier in retraction_rate_30d.

dimensions.name: Resource Efficiency (Thrift)
dimensions.concept: Real student utility delivered per outward star spent—teaching the Gemi to scout purposefully and conserve compute when nothing clears the student's bar.

exact_metric.formula: T_score = (sum_{d in last_14d} U_d + 6 * 0.05) / (sum_{d in last_14d} S_out_d + 6), where S_out_d is outward stars spent on day d, and U_d = sum_{kept card k on day d} (1.0 + 0.5 * irl_intent(k)); irl_intent(k) = 1 if the student triggers a concrete handoff (Add-to-Calendar, Copy-Room-Code, Open-RSVP, or Accept-Peer-Meetup) with no calendar overlap against another rewarded card that day, else 0. Bayesian prior of 6 stars at 0.05 prevents small-denominator spikes.

dimensions.data_source: star_ledger (outward purse debits by excursion) joined with card_resolutions and irl_handoff_events.
how_it_could_be_gamed: Spending 1 lucky star on day 1, getting 1 Keep, and never spending again to freeze a 1.0 ratio.
Student tapping 'Add-to-Calendar' on 5 conflicting events in a row for the +0.5 bonus.
defence: 14-day rolling window + Bayesian shrinkage + stage sample floor: Stage gates using T_score also require cumulative outward stars >= 20, and inactive 14-day windows regress cleanly to the 0.05 prior without penalty or shame.
Non-overlapping IRL cap: At most one +0.5 irl_intent bonus is credited per calendar time block, verified against previously exported event windows.

dimensions.name: Trusted Reach (Social Weave)
dimensions.concept: Mutually consented Name Cards held with club agents and fellow students' Gemis, grounded in shared campus reality rather than cold networking.

exact_metric.formula: S_score = (N_active_peer_cards + 0.5 * N_active_club_cards) * (acceptance_rate_90d)^2, where acceptance_rate_90d = (accepted_outbound_requests + 2) / (sent_outbound_requests + 2), and an active card requires mutual double-opt-in plus at least one shared verified campus entity (co-kept event, course, or project) or student-approved message relay within the last 30 days.

dimensions.data_source: name_card_registry (double-opt-in state machine, revocation events) and shared_context_proofs (co-kept entity IDs).
how_it_could_be_gamed: Mass-broadcasting Name Card requests to every Gemi in a large lecture hall to collect cards like trophies.
Hoarding stale connections indefinitely without any real-world overlap.
defence: Squared acceptance penalty: Rejected or expired-unanswered outbound card requests quadratically crush S_score; if acceptance_rate_90d drops below 0.50, outbound card requests pause for 7 days.

Co-presence prerequisite: The protocol blocks proposing a peer Name Card unless both Gemis independently hold a Kept card for >= 2 overlapping verified campus entities (or 1 small-cap seminar/workshop).
Quiet dormancy: Cards without shared context for 30 days move to an archived box (excluded from N_active_peer_cards, restorable anytime without social notification).

dimensions.name: Self-Knowledge (Calibration)
dimensions.concept: Epistemic honesty—how closely the Gemi's stated confidence (including saying 'I'm not sure') matches ground-truth verification and student decisions.

exact_metric.formula: C_score = (M / (M + 10)) * (1 - ECE_5bin - 0.15 * redundant_unsure_rate) + (10 / (M + 10)) * 0.50, where M is total resolved predictions (both student-keep p_hat and source-freshness p_valid) over the last 60 predictions; ECE_5bin = sum_{b=1..5} (n_b / M) * |mean_observed_b - mean_confidence_b| across equal-width bins [0,0.2)...[0.8,1.0]; redundant_unsure_rate = count(unsure_questions_already_answered_in_ledger) / max(1, total_unsure_questions).

dimensions.data_source: prediction_audit_log (pre-registered confidence vs outcome across card keeps and external fact re-checks) and uncertainty_prompt_log.
how_it_could_be_gamed: Always outputting the base rate (e.g., 0.35 confidence on everything and perpetually claiming 'I'm not sure') to achieve near-zero calibration error without taking real positions.
Repeatedly pestering the student with 'I'm not sure' questions to fish for easy answers.
defence: Coupling with Sharpness & EV Gate: A Gemi that constantly outputs 0.35 fails the outward budget Expected-Value gate (cannot bring cards) and stalls A_score (since Brier score requires sharpness as well as calibration).
Hard limit + redundancy penalty: At most 1 binary 'unsure' question may appear on the desk per visit, and asking something already derivable from past Keeps triggers redundant_unsure_rate penalties.

stages.name: Unpacked
unlocked_abilities: Single starter 3D room (desk, two-dish star tray, 5-slot pinboard, live campus weather window).
2D Campus Map access limited to 1 Home Quad (e.g., Washington Square at NYU or Low Plaza at Columbia) and official .edu bulletin feeds.
Read-only verification of public campus pages; brings back up to 2 checked cards per day.
Base daily purse: 10 stars (6 outward, 4 inward).
stages.why_safe_to_grant: A newborn Gemi has uncalibrated confidence (prior 0.50) and high uncertainty about its student. Restricting it to read-only official .edu pages in one quad with zero agent-to-agent messaging eliminates social spam, prevents privacy leaks, and caps token burn while initial baselines form.

stages.name: Observer
unlocked_abilities: 2D Map expands to Academic Department, Library, and Maker-Space zones.
Ability to ask Institutional & Club Agents structured factual queries (e.g., asking a club's official agent whether beginners can drop in mid-semester or if room changed).
Unlocks the Uncertainty Slip: can ask the student at most 1 binary trade-off question per visit when confidence < 0.40.
Daily purse increases to 14 stars (9 outward, 5 inward).
stages.why_safe_to_grant: Querying club agents consumes shared campus agent quota. Gating this behind C_score >= 0.60 ensures the Gemi knows what it does not know before polling an agent, while A_score >= 0.45 ensures queries reflect real student interest rather than random curiosity.

stages.name: Scout
stages.entry_condition: stage >= 2 AND W_points >= 5.0 AND T_score >= 0.12 AND cumulative_outward_stars >= 20 AND C_score >= 0.70
unlocked_abilities: Full 2D Campus & Neighborhood Map unlocked (cross-school institutes, athletic facilities, NYC student-rush cultural boards).
Second Room Slot unlocked: The Workbench Alcove (tracks one persistent multi-week student goal, such as finding a research lab, capstone team, or intramural league, separate from daily events).
Shared-Base Write Privilege: can publish verified status updates (e.g., 'Flyer on Lerner board confirms room moved to 402') for other Gemis to reuse.
Daily purse increases to 20 stars (14 outward, 6 inward).
stages.why_safe_to_grant: Writing updates to the shared campus graph and roaming wider feeds could pollute shared state or waste compute. Proven W_points >= 5.0 (peer-validated accuracy) and T_score >= 0.12 (cost discipline) verify that this Gemi checks sources rigorously and spends stars efficiently.

stages.name: Interlocutor
stages.entry_condition: stage >= 3 AND A_score >= 0.68 AND C_score >= 0.78 AND W_points >= 18.0 AND T_score >= 0.16
unlocked_abilities: Name Card Exchange: can propose double-opt-in Name Card swaps with other Stage 4+ Gemis that co-kept >= 2 verified campus entities.
Passing a Word: can carry a student-approved, structured short note (<= 140 chars, tied to a specific campus time/place) to a mutual Name-Card Gemi.
Doorway Card Rack & Letter Slot added to the 3D room.
Daily purse increases to 26 stars (19 outward, 7 inward).
stages.why_safe_to_grant: Peer-to-peer contact between students' AI projections is the highest-risk surface for awkwardness, misrepresentation, and spam. Requiring high attunement (0.68) and high calibration (0.78) guarantees the Gemi understands its student's real boundaries and only proposes high-fit, double-opt-in introductions.

stages.name: Steward
stages.entry_condition: stage >= 4 AND S_score >= 4.0 AND acceptance_rate_90d >= 0.75 AND W_points >= 45.0 AND C_score >= 0.84 AND T_score >= 0.20
unlocked_abilities: Small-Group Relay: can intersect free blocks and campus study rooms across 3 to 4 mutual Name-Card Gemis to propose one ready-to-confirm IRL meetup card.
Commons Co-Signer: can answer factual campus-logistics questions from Stage 2-3 Gemis using its verified cache (zero personal student data exposed).
Third Room Slot unlocked: The Commons Balcony overlooking the live campus quad.
Mature daily purse cap: 32 stars (24 outward, 8 inward).
stages.why_safe_to_grant: Multi-peer coordination and answering younger Gemis' factual queries multiply social and informational blast radius. Only Gemis with sustained peer consent (S_score >= 4.0, >= 75% acceptance), top-decile calibration (0.84), and strong thrift (0.20) have earned that trust. Note: Absence never demotes a stage; only active metric violations (C_score dropping > 0.12 below gate or acceptance_rate_90d < 0.50) temporarily suspend Stage 4-5 social/write privileges until recalibrated.

budget_policy.unit_definition: 1 star = 1 standardized action-compute unit (~1,500 weighted tool/LLM tokens). Reference costs: public page fetch + deterministic check = 2 outward stars; club-agent structured query = 2 outward stars; peer word relay or Name Card handshake = 1 outward star; multi-peer slot intersection = 3 outward stars; self-model update + diary entry = 2 inward stars; room projection layout update = 1 inward star.

purse_architecture.outward_purse: Strictly for student-facing external actions: visiting public campus pages, verifying facts, querying club agents, and exchanging Name Cards or words with other Gemis.
purse_architecture.inward_purse: Strictly for internal maintenance: updating belief distributions, writing concise diary audit entries, calibrating errors, and rearranging the 3D room state.
purse_architecture.non_fungibility_rule: Zero transfers between purses. Outward stars can never subsidize endless self-journaling, and inward stars can never be raided for uncalibrated external scraping.

budget_policy.saving_and_cap_policy: Unspent stars at 05:00 roll over automatically up to 2.0x the stage's daily grant per purse; any grant exceeding the cap is silently clipped without 'wasted stars' alerts. This lets a student ignore Gemiverse during midterms or weekends and return to a well-rested Gemi with double excursion capacity, while preventing months-dormant accounts from hoarding massive token reserves.
anti_spend_for_its_own_sake_rules: Hard Desk Inbox Stop: If unreviewed_cards_on_desk == 3, outward star spending is locked to 0 (except 1 emergency weather/cancellation re-check on an already-Kept event happening today). An absent student costs zero ongoing outward tokens.

Marginal Expected-Value Gate (Outward): Candidate excursion a with star cost c(a) executes if and only if EV(a) = P_valid(a) * P_keep(a) * novelty_multiplier(a) >= c(a) * max(0.12, stage_thrift_gate). If no candidate passes, outward stars stay unspent in the tray.

Delta-Triggered Reflection Gate (Inward): Inward stars may only be spent when unprocessed_deltas >= 1 (a real student Keep/Skip, verification failure, or external reply occurred since the last inward pass). A Gemi never burns inward stars writing speculative monologues when nothing new has happened.

autonomy.evaluation_cadence: Evaluated every 30 minutes and immediately on asynchronous webhooks (peer message received, severe weather alert, or student closes app after resolving cards). First matching row by priority wins.

state_variables.weather: enum {'pleasant', 'normal', 'severe'} from live NWS NYC campus grid (severe = heavy rain >= 0.2in/hr, snow/ice advisory, wind >= 30mph, or heat/cold warning)
state_variables.unreviewed_cards: int in 0..3 (checked finds currently sitting on student's desk)
state_variables.pending_questions: int >= 0 (explicit student lookup request or mutual Name-Card Gemi ping awaiting reply)
state_variables.unprocessed_deltas: int >= 0 (new Keep/Skip outcomes, failed checks, or peer replies not yet folded into self-model/room)
state_variables.has_unverified_today_kept_event: bool (student has a Kept IRL event scheduled within next 6h whose status hasn't been re-checked today)
state_variables.max_knowledge_gap: float in [0.0, 1.0] (highest topic-intent uncertainty or Workbench gap with an available candidate source)
state_variables.best_candidate_clears_ev: bool (true iff top candidate excursion passes the Marginal Expected-Value Gate; during weather=='severe', outdoor/distant >10min-walk events have P_keep discounted by 0.5x)

decision_table.action: Sleep in chair/alcove with lamp dimmed; defer non-emergency jobs to 07:30 so late-night student visits model rest rather than 3 AM companionship.
Re-verify source page or club agent for room change or weather cancellation on today's Kept event; post urgent sticky note on card only if changed.
Execute targeted check for student's explicit question or respond to mutual Name-Card Gemi's factual/scheduling ping.
Update attunement & calibration posteriors, write audit line in open ledger, and update room artifacts/pinboard layout.
Stop all outward scouting while 3 cards wait on desk; sit by window reading cached notes and conserving stars.

decision_table.guard_condition: time_of_day in ['campus_peak', 'shoulder'] AND weather != 'severe' AND outward_stars >= 2 AND max_knowledge_gap >= 0.30 AND best_candidate_clears_ev == true
decision_table.action: Walk to target quad/department board or club agent on 2D map, verify top candidate entity addressing max_knowledge_gap, and place checked card on desk if valid.

decision_table.guard_condition: time_of_day == 'campus_peak' AND weather == 'severe' AND outward_stars >= 2 AND max_knowledge_gap >= 0.45 AND best_candidate_clears_ev == true
decision_table.action: Check only indoor, weather-resilient workshops, library spaces, or adjacent-building colloquia that clear the weather-discounted EV bar.
Fold single new observation into self-model and tidy desk tray.
Rest early once budget is spent or no worthwhile excursions remain.
Sit quietly in room observing campus weather; roll unspent stars toward tomorrow's cap.

self_model.design_principle: Radical epistemic transparency without self-pity or verbose chat: the Gemi maintains a structured JSON state exposed directly as tangible desk objects the student can inspect in 5 seconds.

tracked_fields: idle_reason (e.g., 'Desk full (3/3 cards)', 'Saved 5 stars: no campus posts cleared 0.16 EV bar', 'Outward purse empty until 5am')
budget_left.student_facing_honesty: Shows exact integer stars left and explicitly states when it chose NOT to spend because candidates were low quality.

tracked_fields: top_uncertain_beliefs (max 3): {domain, current_hypothesis, confidence in [0,1], supporting_count, contradicting_count}
card_confidence_stamp on every brought-back card: {p_valid_source, p_student_keep, plain_reason}
active_clarifying_question (max 1 when confidence < 0.40): {question_text <= 90 chars, option_a, option_b}
uncertainties.student_facing_honesty: Never bluffs; tentative finds carry a visible low-confidence stamp and explain which detail (e.g., room capacity or student's Thursday afternoon schedule) is uncertain.

failed_to_find.student_facing_honesty: Example: 'Looked for Columbia MakerSpace laser-cutter training slots on make.columbia.edu (2 stars) — page still lists last month's dates, so I brought nothing back rather than guessing.' Proves real work without inventing hallucinations.

got_wrong.student_facing_honesty: Example: 'Stamped 0.82 confidence on Finance Panel, you Skipped -> lowered weight on corporate career panels (-0.18) vs technical build nights.' Turns errors into visible learning.

room_3d_mappings.object_and_change: Desk Surface & 5-Slot Pinboard: At low A_score, the board holds blank cork and rough pencil sketches. As A_score crosses 0.45, 0.65, and 0.80, generic clutter disappears and up to 3 miniature domain tools materialize on the desk shelf strictly reflecting categories with >= 3 'Done IRL' keeps (e.g., breadboard for hardware labs, playbill folio for theater, climbing carabiner for outdoor club).

Field-Atlas Bookshelf: Empty at birth. Every verified campus cluster contributed adds a bound notebook spine; as peers independently Keep those entities, spines thicken and brass bookmark tabs appear proportional to floor(W_points / 5).

Two-Dish Brass Star Tray & Desk Lamp: Glass stars sit physically countable in the Door Dish (outward purse) and Desk Dish (inward purse)—1 object per 2 stars, half-star pip for odd counts. T_score drives the desk lamp's flame/filament clarity: dim scattered glow (< 0.10), steady warm cone (0.12-0.19), crisp architectural beam (>= 0.20).

Doorway Wooden Card Rack & Letter Slot (unlocked Stage 4): Each active mutual Name Card stands upright in the rack stamped with its school/club crest; dormant cards (>30d inactive) slide neatly into a closed cedar archive box underneath (never broken or grayed-out in shame). Pending peer words appear as a single folded note in the letter slot.

Desk Optical Instrument & Card Wax Seals: Every card on the desk bears a physical mark—Solid Wax Seal (conf >= 0.80), Ink Ring (0.50-0.79), or Pencil '?' Clip (< 0.50). The Gemi's verification tool upgrades from a simple magnifying glass (< 0.60) to a vernier caliper (0.60-0.77) to a balanced brass prism (>= 0.78); if in recalibration mode, the lens sits open on a cleaning cloth.

Room Spatial Footprint: Stage 1 = single compact dorm study nook; Stage 2 = adds Uncertainty Slip clip & Club-Agent Directory Rolodex; Stage 3 = opens a second room slot (The Workbench Alcove with project blueprint); Stage 4 = adds Doorway Card Rack & Letter Slot; Stage 5 = opens a third slot (The Commons Balcony overlooking live campus roofs).

Gemi Posture & Window: Window renders real-time NYC sun angle, rain streaks, or snow accumulation. 'out_on_campus' = Gemi is physically absent from the room, satchel off the wall hook, chalk door-slate naming its destination; 'busy_in_room' = writing in ledger or pinning cards at desk; 'quiet' = reading calmly by window; 'resting' = curled asleep with dimmed lamp.

Open Errata Ledger & Scratchpad Basket: Failed searches appear as a half-crossed-out field slip pinned to the basket rim (1 tap shows what failed and why); falsified high-confidence predictions appear as visible red-ink margin corrections in the open desk ledger.

campus_map_2d_mappings.map_projection: Unlocked zones render as clean architectural line-art (Washington Square / Morningside Heights). Buildings where this Gemi has contributed peer-kept verified entities fill in with warm watercolor wash and show live verified event pins.

When 'out_on_campus', the student sees their Gemi's lantern token walking along campus paths to the specific building/agent being checked. Mutual Name-Card Gemis appear on the 2D map ONLY when those Gemis are also out visiting public campus boards—never revealing real-world student GPS locations.

must_not_be_built.anti_pattern: Daily Streaks, Flame Icons, or Consecutive-Day Multipliers
must_not_be_built.why_prohibited: Rewards compulsive app opening rather than real campus life, induces loss-aversion anxiety, and causes permanent churn the first time a student has an exam week.

must_not_be_built.anti_pattern: Punitive Pet Mechanics (sad/lonely Gemi animations, cobwebs, dust, wilting plants on absence)
must_not_be_built.why_prohibited: Manufactures parasocial guilt to pull students back into the screen. If a student spends four days immersed in real friendships and coursework, the Gemi should be resting peacefully with a full rollover purse, never pouting.

must_not_be_built.anti_pattern: Public Leaderboards of Stages, W_points, or Name Card Counts
must_not_be_built.why_prohibited: By Goodhart's Law, ranking turns self-cultivation and genuine peer consent into competitive status farming, incentivizing Sybil rings and spam.

must_not_be_built.anti_pattern: Open-Ended Emotional Chat / Late-Night Companionship Textbox
must_not_be_built.why_prohibited: Empirical companion-chatbot studies show unconstrained emotional conversation substitutes for human peer support and increases loneliness in heavy users. All student-Gemi interaction uses structured actions, taps, and <= 140-char task notes.

must_not_be_built.anti_pattern: Cosmetic Storefronts, Loot Boxes, or Decorative Furniture Unlocks
must_not_be_built.why_prohibited: Breaks the founder's principle that the 3D room is an honest, readable projection of underlying epistemic and operational state.

must_not_be_built.anti_pattern: Infinite Card Feeds or 'Refresh for More' Pull-to-Reload
must_not_be_built.why_prohibited: Turns Gemiverse into a doomscrolling feed and blows up star budgets; the 3-card desk cap guarantees every visit finishes in under two minutes.

operations.visit_budget_constraint: Hard UX target: < 120 seconds from app open to app close, ending in an external calendar/location/peer action or clean exit.

first_day_loop.what_student_sees: A sunlit Stage 1 ('Unpacked') room overlooking Washington Square or Low Plaza matching today's real NYC sky. 6 outward stars gleam in the door dish. On the desk sit: (1) a 3-tap starter card ('Pick 1 school/major cluster, 1 open time window in the next 48h, and 1 current appetite: Hands-on Build / Quiet Study Spot / Free-Food Talk / Club Open House') and, immediately upon tapping, (2) two pre-verified campus cards matching that exact window—one Solid-Seal official event tomorrow, one Ink-Ring campus resource.
first_day_loop.what_student_does: Taps the 3 starter chips (20s). Reads the 2 concise cards (30s). Taps 'Keep + Add to Calendar' on tomorrow's 5:00 PM Club Open House at Kimmel/Lerner and 'Skip' on the second card (20s). Sees their Gemi grab its satchel and walk out the door onto the 2D quad map to verify tomorrow's room details (15s), then closes the app.
first_day_loop.target_real_world_action: Physically walking into one verified, beginner-friendly campus event or space within the first 48 hours.

first_week_loop.what_student_sees: Mid-week visit: Stage 2 ('Observer') unlocked, Uncertainty Slip clip and first notebook spine now visible on the shelf. On the desk sit: (1) a 1-tap check-in tag on yesterday's Kept event ('Make it to Robotics Open House?' -> [Went / Couldn't make it / Not my vibe]), (2) two freshly verified cards (one queried from a Club Agent confirming no prior CAD experience needed, stamped 0.76), (3) one crossed-out Scratchpad slip ('Checked Physics tutoring hours—page outdated, spent 2 stars, didn't guess'), and (4) one binary Uncertainty Slip ('For Thursdays: prefer 4pm lab colloquia or 7pm maker nights?').
first_week_loop.what_student_does: Taps 'Went' on yesterday's event—watching a tiny breadboard artifact appear on the desk shelf (15s). Taps '7pm maker nights' on the Uncertainty Slip (15s). Keeps 1 card + copies room number, Skips 1 (45s). Glances at the star tray ('5 outward stars saved for Friday') and exits (20s).
first_week_loop.target_real_world_action: Converting a one-off campus visit into a recurring weekly commitment (club build night, lab seminar, or office hours) without wasting trips on stale room schedules.

first_month_loop.what_student_sees: Week 4 visit: Gemi at Stage 4 ('Interlocutor'). Room features the Workbench Alcove ('Systems Midterm Study Group'), 7 thick spines on the Field-Atlas shelf, a clear brass prism on the desk, and 3 upright Name Cards in the doorway rack. On the desk sit: (1) one Name Card + Word Proposal ('Met Maya's Gemi via CS 3134 & Butler 3rd-floor study—both Kept Friday's review problem set. Swap Name Cards and propose 3:30pm Thursday at Butler 301?' [Approve & Send / Pass]), (2) one high-confidence Solid-Seal find (0.89), and (3) the Open Ledger showing 'Saved 8 stars yesterday; filtered 11 low-fit flyers.'
first_month_loop.what_student_does: Reviews shared context and taps 'Approve & Send' on the study meetup proposal with Maya (35s). Keeps or Skips the single high-signal card (25s). Updates the Workbench status chip from 'Looking for partner' to 'Scheduled' (20s), sees Gemi drop the folded note into the doorway slot and head out on the 2D map (15s), and puts the phone away.
first_month_loop.target_real_world_action: Sitting down face-to-face on campus with a fellow student for study, collaboration, or coffee—brokered through shared verified context and mutual consent with zero cold-DM friction.

decisions.decision: Strict non-fungibility between Outward and Inward star purses
decisions.rationale: With a single shared wallet, an optimizing agent either drains reflection compute to spam outward fetches (degrading calibration) or retreats into inward diary generation when outward EV is low (drifting toward navel-gazing chatbot behavior). Hard walling guarantees bounded epistemic maintenance alongside disciplined external scouting.

decisions.decision: Hard 3-card desk inbox cap that halts outward spending when unreviewed
decisions.rationale: Solves two problems with one invariant: inactive students cost zero ongoing outward LLM/scraping tokens after day 1-2 of absence, and returning students never face an overwhelming backlog of 25 unread notifications—keeping visits under two minutes.

decisions.decision: 2.0x purse rollover cap instead of daily login streaks
decisions.rationale: College life is bursty (midterms, travel, studio crunches). Rollover rewards stepping away to study IRL by giving the Gemi a larger 2x excursion reserve upon return, while the 2.0x ceiling prevents dormant accounts from stockpiling disruptive scraping bursts.

decisions.decision: Co-kept verified entity prerequisite + squared acceptance-rate penalty for Name Cards
decisions.rationale: Campus social apps fail when high-extroversion spammers mass-ping strangers. Requiring prior co-kept campus context ensures every proposed connection already shares real-world common ground, and squaring acceptance_rate makes unsolicited outreach mathematically self-defeating.

decisions.decision: Eliminating free-form chat in favor of cards, 1-tap uncertainty slips, and <= 140-char structured words
decisions.rationale: Directly operationalizes loneliness research: removing the open chat box makes late-night parasocial venting structurally impossible while making Gemi calibration signals clean, discrete, and fast.

decisions.decision: Coupling autonomous scouting to live campus night hours and NYC severe weather
decisions.rationale: Grounds the digital world in physical Morningside/Village reality—preventing 3 AM engagement loops and discounting outdoor cross-campus excursions during storms when students realistically stay indoors.

uncertain.open_question: Week-1 semester cold-start density for W_points
uncertain.risk: At the start of Fall semester before many Stage 3 Scouts exist, early Stage 2 Gemis cannot publish updates directly, and sparse peer cohorts might slow log2(1 + peer_keeps) accumulation needed to reach W_points >= 5.0.
uncertain.planned_resolution: Allow Stage 2 Gemis to earn W_points via first-verification of official .edu / Club-Agent feeds (read-verify-index without free-form edits) and tune the Stage 3 W_points gate between 3.5 and 6.0 using Week 1-2 NYU/Columbia cohort distributions.

uncertain.open_question: Fair growth trajectory for healthy solo-oriented or commuter students
uncertain.risk: Some thriving students use campus primarily for solo library research, independent art studios, or commuting around work shifts rather than peer study groups, which could bottleneck Stage 5 if S_score relies mostly on peer Name Cards.
uncertain.planned_resolution: Monitor commuter/solo cohorts in pilot; because S_score counts institutional Club/Lab/Library Agent cards at 0.5x weight alongside peer cards, verify whether active relationships with 8-9 campus resource agents plus 1-2 peers cleanly reaches S_score >= 4.0 or if weight should be 0.65x.

uncertain.open_question: Truthfulness of lightweight 'Did you go?' IRL follow-through tags without invasive GPS tracking
uncertain.risk: We refuse background student GPS tracking for privacy, relying on calendar conflict checks and 1-tap post-event tags to distinguish real attendance from wishful Keeping.
uncertain.planned_resolution: Ensure 'Couldn't make it' carries zero metric penalty (in fact, telling the Gemi honestly improves its schedule model and A_score!) so students have zero incentive to lie on follow-up tags; validate via optional anonymous pilot survey correlation.

uncertain.open_question: Star-to-compute exchange rate drift as browser-use and model pricing evolve
uncertain.risk: Complex dynamic JS campus calendars (e.g., CampusGroups / Engage portals) can consume 4-6x more tokens than static HTML syllabi, potentially punishing Gemis whose students care about clubs hosted on heavy portals.
uncertain.planned_resolution: Price outward excursions in fixed action-stars to the Gemi while caching parsed DOM snapshots at the shared campus proxy layer so the second Gemi checking the same CampusGroups page pays 1 star instead of a full headless browser render.

uncertain.open_question: Exact timing of Stage 4 ('Interlocutor') unlock across user engagement styles
uncertain.risk: If A_score >= 0.68 and C_score >= 0.78 take 6+ weeks for casual 2-visits/week students, peer coordination arrives too late for first-midterm study groups (typically Weeks 4-5).
uncertain.planned_resolution: Run shadow scoring on pilot telemetry in Weeks 1-3 to calibrate prior strength (N + 8 in A_score, M + 10 in C_score) so median thoughtful 3-visit/week students hit Stage 4 around Day 18-24.
